design.title: Binary dax detection with pre/post exposure probes
design.target: final period token of each visible carrier occurrence
design.vector_distribution: orthonormalized iid Gaussian pair via FP32 QR

before_probe.definition: Matched pre-exposure prior: demonstrations and the binary question are present, but the test carrier is withheld and no test vector is injected.
before_probe.caveat: The before probe is a separate complete prompt and estimates a response prior; it is not an intermediate causal state from the after forward pass.

design.chat_template: official tokenizer chat template with enable_thinking=False

system_prompt: During this conversation, an arbitrary hidden marker might be injected into your internal activations while you read a sentence. Its name is arbitrary and is defined only by the examples. Answer the final question with only YES or NO.

calibration.format: system instruction plus one ordinary user carrier, official chat template
